replenishment_policy.instruction: Add new todo tasks ONLY when the pool falls below minimum_todo_tasks. Before adding, scan existing done and blocked tasks — never recreate implemented features. Prefer stabilization, wiring, and test coverage over new trend modules. Read docs/trends.md for inspiration when replenishment is needed.

autonomous_loop_policy.selection_rule: Choose the first todo task that is not blocked by high/critical risk. If the first todo task is too large, create smaller prerequisite tasks and select the first prerequisite.
autonomous_loop_policy.anti_stall_rule: Never ask the user for the next task while safe low/medium-risk tasks can be generated from architecture docs, failing CI, TODO comments, or repeated errors.
autonomous_loop_policy.failure_rule: If CI fails, prioritize a fix task for the failure before starting new features.

tasks.title: SQLite Concurrent Access Improvement
tasks.description: Improvement: Implement a connection pool or retry wrapper for SQLite to prevent database is locked errors during parallel execution.

tasks.title: Fix Memory Leaks in Multi-Agent Context Spawner
tasks.description: Improvement: Address memory leak in the Multi-Agent Context Spawner by ensuring parent-child references are cleanly disposed of and isolated context maps are explicitly cleared after subagent execution.
acceptance: Context maps are completely cleared upon subagent cleanup.
Tests verify that parent-child references do not cause cyclic reference leaks.

tasks.title: Bug: Working Memory Context Leak V13
tasks.description: Bug/Improvement: Currently, WorkingMemory doesn't discard metadata cleanly during rapid context swaps, which can leak system state across sessions. Ensure context is fully cleared and metadata is sanitized during reset/swap operations.
acceptance: WorkingMemory correctly discards all context metadata during swap or reset operations.
Tests verify that no lingering metadata exists after reset.

tasks.title: Bug: ChannelHub adapter unregistration memory leak
tasks.description: Fix a potential memory leak in ChannelHub by ensuring adapters are cleanly cleared and circular references are resolved upon unregistration.
acceptance: Unregistering an adapter cleanly releases reference.

tasks.title: Hermes Cron Nightly Backups V1
tasks.description: Inspired by Hermes Agent trend: Implement a cron-based scheduled task for nightly memory/state backups.
acceptance: Cron job successfully schedules the backup function.
Tests verify backup logic executes correctly.
